A New Beginning#001.src: Halt! I'll need to see some form of identification.
A New Beginning#001.dst: 站住！我需要看一下你的身分證明。
A New Beginning#001.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#002.src: New policy, sorry for the inconvenience. We're heightening security around here.
A New Beginning#002.dst: 新規定，不好意思麻煩你了。我們最近在加強這一帶的戒備。
A New Beginning#002.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#003.src: It shouldn't take too much of your time, don't worry! Just show us your citizen identification papers, and we'll let you on through.
A New Beginning#003.dst: 不會耽誤你太久的，別擔心！把公民身分文件拿出來給我們看看，我們就放你過去。
A New Beginning#003.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#006.src: What's taking so long? It can't be that hard to find those. You should have them on your person at all times.
A New Beginning#006.dst: 怎麼拖這麼久？那東西應該不難找吧。你本來就該隨身帶著。
A New Beginning#006.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#007.src: It’s a very new restriction. There was some incident nearby. I’m not sure on the details, but-
A New Beginning#007.dst: 這是很新的限制。附近出了點事。詳情我也不太清楚，可是——
A New Beginning#007.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#008.src: Enough stalling. Where are your papers?
A New Beginning#008.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#009.src: If you don’t present identification, I’m going to need to take you in for questioning.
A New Beginning#009.dst: 你要是拿不出身分證明，我就得把你帶回去問話了。
A New Beginning#009.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#010.src: O-oh, hey, th-there you are! Gosh, I was w-wondering where you'd gotten off to!
A New Beginning#010.dst: 哦、哦，嘿，你、你在這裡啊！天啊，我還在、還在想你跑到哪去了呢！

A New Beginning#011.src: Ha... d-don't tell me you forgot your papers again! I k-keep telling you to keep th-them with you...
A New Beginning#011.dst: 哈……別、別跟我說你又忘了帶文件！我一、一直跟你說要隨、隨身帶著的……

A New Beginning#012.src: One of th-these days, you'll remember! F-for sure...
A New Beginning#012.dst: 總、總有一天你會記得的！一、一定會……

A New Beginning#013.src: You d-didn’t forget our conversation too, d-did you? S-s-sorry for my friend, sir!
A New Beginning#013.dst: 你該不會連我們剛才、剛才在講什麼也忘了吧？不、不好意思啊長官，我朋友就這樣！

A New Beginning#014.src: Ahem. I'll still need to see identification if you want to enter the city.
A New Beginning#014.dst: 咳咳。你們要進城，我還是得看身分證明。
A New Beginning#014.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#015.src: Oh! O-o-of course! L-let me just...
A New Beginning#015.dst: 哦！當、當然！讓我找、找一下……

A New Beginning#016.src: ...They're a-around here s-s-somewhere, I'm s-sure... I think they m-might be
A New Beginning#016.dst: ……應該就在這、這附近……我想它可、可能是——

A New Beginning#017.src: Aha! Here! Identification p-papers, just for y-you!
A New Beginning#017.dst: 啊哈！在這！身、身分文件，專程給你看的！

A New Beginning#018.src: ...What even is this? I can barely read the handwriting... Is that Sovereign Selium's signature? The previous sovereign?
A New Beginning#018.dst: ……這到底是什麼東西？我幾乎看不懂這字跡……那是 Selium 統領的簽名嗎？上一任統領的？
A New Beginning#018.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#019.src: I've had enough of these games. The two of you are under
A New Beginning#019.dst: 我受夠這種把戲了。你們兩個現在——
A New Beginning#019.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#022.src: We've received more information about the incident at {p}. There's a new cursed one to look out for. Dozens of soldiers were killed in an attempt to capture them.
A New Beginning#022.dst: 我們收到更多關於 {p} 那起事件的消息。又出現一個受詛者要留意。為了抓他，死了幾十名士兵。
A New Beginning#022.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#023.src: We're taking reinforcements to the fort, but I need you to remain at your posts. Keep a watchful eye on any suspicious individuals.
A New Beginning#023.dst: 我們要調增援到堡壘去，但你們留在崗位上。任何可疑人物都給我盯緊。
A New Beginning#023.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#024.src: ...Th-this might be a good time to run. While they're distracted! Quick, f-follow me!
A New Beginning#024.dst: ……現、現在跑正好。趁他們分心的時候！快、快跟我來！

A New Beginning#025.src: Understood. Now, back to where did they go?!
A New Beginning#025.dst: 明白。好了，回到——他們人呢？！
A New Beginning#025.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#027.src: Phew... G-glad we got out of there...
A New Beginning#027.dst: 呼……還、還好我們溜出來了……

A New Beginning#028.src: A-anyway. What were you th-thinking? Trying to enter the city without p-papers...
A New Beginning#028.dst: 總、總之。你在想什麼啊？沒帶文、文件就想進城……

A New Beginning#029.src: You're n-new around here, right? Transferred in f-from elsewhere. Y-you're interesting, though.
A New Beginning#029.dst: 你是剛、剛來這一帶的吧？從別的地方轉、轉過來的。不過你、你這個人挺有意思的。

A New Beginning#030.src: Um. The thing at T-Torann... you w-wouldn't happen to... n-n-nevermind. I don't need to know!
A New Beginning#030.dst: 呃。T-Torann 那件事……你該不會、不會是……算、算了。我不需要知道！

A New Beginning#031.src: But, if y-you're interested... The military k-keeps records of these sorts of things! Th-they want a paper trail... or s-something.
A New Beginning#031.dst: 不過，如、如果你有興趣的話……軍方會把這、這類事情都記錄下來！他們要留紙、紙本存底……之類的。

A New Beginning#032.src: You d-didn't hear this from me... but the l-leaves have whispered something about th-the location of a record storage. Here, hand me that b-book of yours...
A New Beginning#032.dst: 這、這話不是我說的……不過葉子低語過一個檔、檔案庫的位置。來，把你那本書給、給我……

A New Beginning#033.src: Well, good luck s-stranger! If anyone asks, we never m-met. But, um... y-you can call me Zeph.
A New Beginning#033.dst: 那、那就祝你好運了，陌生人！有人問起的話，我們從、從來沒見過。不過，呃……你可以叫我 Zeph。
A New Beginning#033.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#034.src: Find your report in the storage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#034.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的檔案庫找出你的檔案。

A New Beginning#036.src: HALT! Intruder! For trespassing on restricted property, you are under
A New Beginning#036.dst: 站住！入侵者！擅闖管制區域，你現在——
A New Beginning#036.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#037.src: Wait, a suspicious person in the region is this the cursed one?! Get them!!
A New Beginning#037.dst: 等等，本區出現的可疑人物——這就是那個受詛者？！抓住他！！
A New Beginning#037.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#038.dst: 他們是衝著……Zhiraok 統領來的……別……你……你……
A New Beginning#038.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#039.src: Well? You've crunched the numbers. Give me the report.
A New Beginning#039.dst: 如何？數字你都算過了。把報告給我。
A New Beginning#039.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#040.src: Sovereign, sir. It seems {p} was not directly prepared to face a cursed one. Dozens of soldiers are dead.
A New Beginning#040.dst: 統領大人。看來 {p} 並沒有真正做好面對受詛者的準備。幾十名士兵陣亡。
A New Beginning#040.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#041.src: ...of all the possibilities. How could that have factored out...? Hm. Who was the commanding officer? Their take on the problem would help fill the gaps.
A New Beginning#041.dst: ……這麼多種可能性裡面。怎麼會因式分解成這樣……？嗯。當時的指揮官是誰？他對這道題的看法可以幫我把缺項補上。
A New Beginning#041.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#042.src: Well... it seems it was Commander Lilles, sir. But he was one of the casualties of the incident, and a replacement has yet to be promoted.
A New Beginning#042.dst: 這個……看來是 Lilles 指揮官，大人。但他也是那場事件的傷亡之一，接替的人選還沒升上來。
A New Beginning#042.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#043.src: Naturally... I'll need to get hold of his family later and break the news. What else do you have on the Cursed One?
A New Beginning#043.dst: 當然是這樣……我晚點得聯絡他的家屬告知消息。關於那名受詛者，你還掌握到什麼？
A New Beginning#043.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#044.src: I've heard reports that they're... from outside. Possibly one of the ones who were invited into our province recently, though nobody seems certain on that.
A New Beginning#044.dst: 我聽說他們……是外面來的。可能是最近受邀進入本行省的那批人之一，不過沒有人敢確定。
A New Beginning#044.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#045.src: We've already raised security in {p}, and we have forces moving to Torann.
A New Beginning#045.dst: 我們已經提高了 {p} 的戒備，並且正在調兵前往 Torann。
A New Beginning#045.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#046.src: One positive in a sea of negatives, I suppose. Good work. File the report in the records room, and then we'll go view the damages for ourselves.
A New Beginning#046.dst: 一堆負數裡總算有一個正的。做得好。把報告歸檔進資料室，然後我們親自去看看損害狀況。
A New Beginning#046.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#047.src: One more thing. Since Torann is compromised, we've taken the liberty of storing the cursed one's report here, so
A New Beginning#047.dst: 還有一件事。既然 Torann 已經失守，我們擅自把那名受詛者的檔案存放在這裡，所以——
A New Beginning#047.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#048.src: Do we not have a higher priority right now?!
A New Beginning#048.dst: 我們現在沒有更高優先的事要處理嗎？！
A New Beginning#048.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#049.src: ...N-n-no, sir. My- my apologies. I simply thought
A New Beginning#049.dst: ……沒、沒有，大人。我——我很抱歉。我只是想——
A New Beginning#049.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#050.src: I have a dozen and a half other problems to solve that need to be pushed back oh, would you put away the key already?
A New Beginning#050.dst: 我還有一打半的問題得往後挪——哦，你到底要不要把鑰匙收起來？
A New Beginning#050.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#051.src: We haven't got time to sit around like this when there's a tragedy of that value to look into! We need to get to {p}, yesterday!
A New Beginning#051.dst: 有那種量級的慘劇要查，我們沒空在這裡耗！我們昨天就該到 {p} 了！
A New Beginning#051.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#052.src: Locate the key inside the eastern tower and retrieve your report.
A New Beginning#052.dst: 到東側塔樓找出鑰匙，取回你的檔案。

A New Beginning#053.src: * Subject brought to {p} by the Driver. (Note: Interrogate Driver for reasoning.)
A New Beginning#053.dst: * 對象由 the Driver 帶往 {p}。（註：需就其理由訊問 the Driver。）
A New Beginning#053.speaker: "Unknown Cursed One"

A New Beginning#055.src: Someone's been here... search the outpost, quickly!
A New Beginning#055.dst: 有人來過這裡……快，搜查整座哨站！

A New Beginning#056.src: Find a way out of Nexiph Outpost.
A New Beginning#056.dst: 想辦法離開 Nexiph 哨站。

A New Beginning#058.src: H-hey again, at the w-window! Tough s-situation, huh?
A New Beginning#058.dst: 嘿、嘿，又見面了，窗、窗戶這邊！情況很棘、棘手吧？
A New Beginning#058.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#059.src: I f-figured you could use a hand... Stand back a m-moment.
A New Beginning#059.dst: 我想你大、大概需要幫手……退、退開一點。
A New Beginning#059.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#061.src: I-I'll be down in a bit. Just h-hold on tight to the rope, and you'll be f-fine!
A New Beginning#061.dst: 我等、等一下就下去。你抓緊繩子就、就沒事了！
A New Beginning#061.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#062.src: Talk to Rex and Zeph at .
A New Beginning#062.dst: 到 跟 Rex 和 Zeph 談話。

A New Beginning#063.src: Phew! W-we got you out. G-good work back there, though!
A New Beginning#063.dst: 呼！我、我們把你弄出來了。不過你剛才表、表現得很好！
A New Beginning#063.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#065.src: D-don't mind her, she's just like that. Rex, this is
A New Beginning#065.dst: 別、別理她，她就是那個樣子。Rex，這位是——
A New Beginning#065.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#066.src: The stranger you found trying to get into {p} without identification, I know. Do you really need me here still?
A New Beginning#066.dst: 就是你發現那個想沒身分證明混進 {p} 的陌生人，我知道。我還有必要待在這裡嗎？
A New Beginning#066.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#067.src: ...I-I-I'd like it if you s-stayed, yes.
A New Beginning#067.dst: 我、我、我希望你留、留下來，是的。
A New Beginning#067.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#069.src: Um... I- I don't think I c-c-caught your name.
A New Beginning#069.dst: 呃……我、我好像還沒聽、聽到你的名字。
A New Beginning#069.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#070.src: {u}... so, wh-where are you from? Y-you must've transferred in from an-another region, right?
A New Beginning#070.dst: {u}……那，你是哪、哪裡人？你一定是從別、別的地區轉過來的吧？
A New Beginning#070.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#071.src: Another... um... wh-what do you-... you d-don't know?
A New Beginning#071.dst: 別的……呃……你說什、什麼——你不、不知道？
A New Beginning#071.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#072.src: Obviously they're not from here, Zeph! Remember that thing I told you about? The big spectacle event they had with people from beyond the gates?
A New Beginning#072.dst: 他們顯然不是這裡的人啊，Zeph！記得我跟你講過的那件事嗎？他們辦的那場大排場，來的人是從城門外面來的。
A New Beginning#072.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#073.src: You w-w-what?! But, there’s- th-that’s not possible...
A New Beginning#073.dst: 你、你說什麼？！可是，那——那不、不可能……
A New Beginning#073.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#074.src: Possible or not, they’re obviously from outside the province! They’re probably involved with that big spectacle event with people from beyond the gates that I was telling you about.
A New Beginning#074.dst: 可不可能不重要，他們顯然是從行省外面來的！他們八成就跟我跟你講過的那場大排場有關，那些從城門外來的人。
A New Beginning#074.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#075.src: …I th-thought you were m-making things up again.
A New Beginning#075.dst: 我、我還以為你又在編、編故事。
A New Beginning#075.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#076.src: Excuse you? I don’t make things up! You can ask Mora, he saw it too.
A New Beginning#076.dst: 你這什麼意思？我才不編故事！你可以去問 Mora，他也看到了。
A New Beginning#076.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#077.src: If you s-say so… I just- I-I-I thought there were no p-people left out there. The c-crown keeps a whole g-garrison stationed to f-fight off… um… m-m-monsters.
A New Beginning#077.dst: 你說是就、就是吧……我只是——我、我、我一直以為外面已經沒、沒有人了。王、王室不是派了一整支駐、駐軍在那邊擋……呃……怪、怪物嗎。
A New Beginning#077.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#079.src: Wh- I d-don’t know! It s-s-sounded believable to me!
A New Beginning#079.dst: 我——我怎、怎麼知道！聽、聽起來很有說服力啊！
A New Beginning#079.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#080.src: Ugh, whatever! I don’t have time for this. Zeph, I have work to do. Just… stay on your guard. I don’t trust whatever’s going on with this stranger.
A New Beginning#080.dst: 唉，算了！我沒空跟你耗。Zeph，我有事要做。你就……小心點。這個陌生人身上的事我一件都不信。
A New Beginning#080.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#082.src: She's- um... she's n-not normally like this. S-sorry about that.
A New Beginning#082.dst: 她、她……呃……她平常不是這樣的。不、不好意思。
A New Beginning#082.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#083.src: O-Oh! I f-followed you, of course.
A New Beginning#083.dst: 哦！我當、當然是跟著你來的啊。
A New Beginning#083.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#084.src: A s-stranger comes to our region without p-papers and is supposedly a c-cursed one? I wasn't letting you go th-that easily!
A New Beginning#084.dst: 一個沒帶文、文件的陌生人來到我們這一帶，還可、可能是受詛者？我哪、哪可能就這樣讓你走！
A New Beginning#084.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#085.src: O-Oh! N-no problem! It was... it w-was nothing. Y-you did most of the work.
A New Beginning#085.dst: 哦！沒、沒什麼！那……那沒什麼。大部分都是你自、自己做的。
A New Beginning#085.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#086.src: N-Nixeph is... n-not an easy place to break into! I g-guess all the guards were gone.
A New Beginning#086.dst: Nixeph 是……不、不容易闖進去的地方！我、我猜是衛兵都調走了。
A New Beginning#086.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#087.src: But, um... y-you got what you needed, and I got what I- what I needed, s-so...
A New Beginning#087.dst: 不過，呃……你拿到你要的，我也拿、拿到我要的，所、所以……
A New Beginning#087.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#088.src: B-besides! I had s-something I needed to get from... f-from the outpost, anyway.
A New Beginning#088.dst: 再、再說了！我本來也有東、東西要從哨站拿。
A New Beginning#088.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#089.src: Um... th-there is someone you should meet. I was told to pass on a m-message...
A New Beginning#089.dst: 呃……有、有個人你應該見一見。有人要我轉、轉達一句話……
A New Beginning#089.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#090.src: And- and you'll be on y-your own this time. N-no help from me!
A New Beginning#090.dst: 而、而且這次你要自己去。我、我不會幫你！
A New Beginning#090.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#091.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#091.dst: 訊息是這樣的：西、西方，巨人扎下它的根。風起時，他們隨、隨之而歌。
A New Beginning#091.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#092.src: "Westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they sing along."
A New Beginning#092.dst: 「西方，巨人扎下它的根。風起時，他們隨之而歌。」

A New Beginning#093.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#093.dst: 訊息是這樣的：西、西方，巨人扎下它的根。風起時，他們隨、隨之而歌。
A New Beginning#093.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#094.src: Talk to the woman in the cave.

A New Beginning#095.src: Well, well. If it isn't a fresh breeze dancing in the leaves...
A New Beginning#095.dst: 哎呀。這不是一陣在葉間起舞的清風嗎……

A New Beginning#096.src: You must be the Cursed One who caused such a stir at Torann, yes? News has spread quickly of your actions.
A New Beginning#096.dst: 你就是在 Torann 掀起那場風波的受詛者吧？你的事蹟傳得很快。

A New Beginning#097.src: I'm impressed you found your way to me.
A New Beginning#097.dst: 你能找到我這裡，我很佩服。

A New Beginning#098.src: So let's get to the business at hand. I'll start with this you're from the Wynn Province, aren't you?
A New Beginning#098.dst: 那我們就談正事。我先從這句開始——你是 Wynn 行省來的，對吧？

A New Beginning#099.src: I thought so... You're certainly not from around here. Though, I would recommend you keep that information close to your chest.
A New Beginning#099.dst: 我猜也是……你顯然不是這一帶的人。不過，我會建議你把這件事藏好。

A New Beginning#100.src: Very few people have knowledge of the outside world, and those that do... they're the ones who will be looking for you. Best to avoid drawing their attention.
A New Beginning#100.dst: 知道外面世界的人非常少，而知道的那些人……正是會來找你的人。最好別引起他們注意。

A New Beginning#101.src: But I should introduce myself. My name is Syndra, leader of the Leaves in the Wind resistance group.
A New Beginning#101.dst: 不過我該自我介紹一下。我叫 Syndra，「風中之葉」反抗組織的領導者。
A New Beginning#101.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#102.src: Call it something of a gamble. Given your... shall we say, explosive entrance into the province, I find it unlikely you're with the crown.
A New Beginning#102.dst: 就當是一場豪賭吧。以你進入本行省的方式——姑且說是「轟轟烈烈」——我不認為你是王室那邊的人。
A New Beginning#102.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#103.src: Even if you chose to reveal my secrets and if anyone even believed you you'd have no guarantee of your own safety.
A New Beginning#103.dst: 就算你選擇把我的祕密說出去，而且真的有人相信你，你自己的安全也一樣沒有保障。
A New Beginning#103.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#104.src: Yes. You haven’t been here long, but you’ve felt it, haven’t you? The crown has its roots buried deep in this province, and it certainly isn’t kind to all.
A New Beginning#104.dst: 是的。你來這裡沒多久，但你已經感覺到了吧？王室的根在這個行省扎得很深，而它對所有人絕不是一樣仁慈的。
A New Beginning#104.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#105.src: Those it sees as disposable… they don’t often make it far. That is why I have taken my role. I’d like to see a day where none are left behind.
A New Beginning#105.dst: 那些被它視為可拋棄的人……大多走不遠。這就是我擔起這個角色的原因。我想看到一個沒有人被拋下的日子。
A New Beginning#105.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#106.src: But that's enough about me. On to you. Why are you here, cursed one? For what purpose have you come to Fruma?
A New Beginning#106.dst: 不過我的事說夠了。換你。你為什麼會在這裡，受詛者？你來 Fruma 的目的是什麼？
A New Beginning#106.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#107.src: Interesting. A sense that something isn't right...
A New Beginning#107.dst: 有意思。一種「哪裡不對勁」的感覺……
A New Beginning#107.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#108.src: To tell you the truth, it's one I've had myself for quite some time. Though, likely for a different reason to you.
A New Beginning#108.dst: 老實說，那種感覺我自己也有很久了。只是原因大概跟你不一樣。
A New Beginning#108.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#109.src: A noble cause… It is one I can wholeheartedly support.
A New Beginning#109.dst: 高尚的理由……那是我可以全心支持的。
A New Beginning#109.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#110.src: In a world like this, the most we can do sometimes is hold on to those we care for. Take care not to lose that drive.
A New Beginning#110.dst: 在這樣的世界裡，我們有時候能做的，也就是牢牢抓住自己在乎的人。小心別把那股動力弄丟了。
A New Beginning#110.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#111.src: Then, I would ask of you one more thing. A test, in a way...
A New Beginning#111.dst: 那麼，我還想請你做一件事。算是一場試煉……
A New Beginning#111.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#112.src: The power you carry the curse you bear. I have seen such things before, yet always at a distance. Never up close.
A New Beginning#112.dst: 你身上帶著的力量——你背負的詛咒。這種東西我以前見過，但一直是遠遠地看。從來沒有近距離看過。
A New Beginning#112.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#113.src: I would ask for a duel. Nothing dangerous, or lethal... I have safeguards in place for myself, so do not test my limits. When I call it, we stop.
A New Beginning#113.dst: 我想跟你決鬥一場。不危險，也不致命……我這邊有保命的手段，所以別去試我的極限。我喊停，我們就停。
A New Beginning#113.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#114.src: I would simply like to see the strength of a cursed one in battle firsthand. So, then. Let us begin!
A New Beginning#114.dst: 我只是想親眼看看一個受詛者在戰鬥中的強度。那麼——開始吧！
A New Beginning#114.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#117.src: Impressive. Very impressive. I have never seen a cursed one with such control and technique...
A New Beginning#117.dst: 了不起。非常了不起。我從沒見過控制力與技巧這麼好的受詛者……
A New Beginning#117.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#118.src: If I did not know better, I would believe you to have been blessed by the crown itself.
A New Beginning#118.dst: 若不是我知道得清楚，我會以為你是受了王室本身的賜福。
A New Beginning#118.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#119.src: Your power, your spells. The ability to bend the world to your whim, to wield the elements for your own gain.
A New Beginning#119.dst: 你的力量、你的法術。那種讓世界順你心意彎折、驅使元素為己所用的能力。
A New Beginning#119.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#120.src: Eons ago, so the stories say, the world was pure and balanced. Our people lived with the land, content with what we had.
A New Beginning#120.dst: 故事說，久遠以前，這個世界是純淨而平衡的。我們的人與土地共生，安於所有。
A New Beginning#120.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#121.src: And yet, an evil force lurked within us, a malice which despised our peace and happiness. One day, it burst forth, granting unimaginable power to those it deemed worthy...
A New Beginning#121.dst: 然而有一股邪惡潛伏在我們之中，它憎恨我們的和平與幸福。有一天它爆發出來，把難以想像的力量賜給它認為配得上的人……
A New Beginning#121.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#122.src: Its power could not be controlled. Those cursed by its touch went on to tear apart the land, destroying cities and towns... fear overtook the land, none were safe.
A New Beginning#122.dst: 那份力量無法被控制。被它碰過而受詛的人，開始撕裂大地、摧毀城鎮……恐懼籠罩整片土地，沒有人是安全的。
A New Beginning#122.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#123.src: Until she arrived, a force of good to counter the evil. She granted her own blessings to the people of Fruma, power which could be controlled and wielded to banish the cursed.
A New Beginning#123.dst: 直到她出現，一股與邪惡抗衡的良善之力。她把自己的祝福賜給 Fruma 的人民，那是可以被控制、可以被駕馭、用來放逐受詛者的力量。
A New Beginning#123.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#124.src: She saved our province, and became our immortal Queen. Always looking out for the people, always alert for the presence of evil... for it could not be killed, only staved off.
A New Beginning#124.dst: 她拯救了我們的行省，成為我們不朽的女王。永遠照看著人民，永遠對邪惡的氣息保持警覺……因為那東西殺不死，只能擋著。
A New Beginning#124.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#125.src: The cursed ones never left. They only grew smarter, more capable of hiding from the crown's watchful eye.
A New Beginning#125.dst: 受詛者從未離去。他們只是變得更聰明，更懂得躲開王室的眼睛。
A New Beginning#125.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#126.src: And so, it tells the people, always be aware. Always be looking for the cursed ones. It is only a matter of time before they hurt you.
A New Beginning#126.dst: 於是王室告訴人民，要時時警醒。要時時提防受詛者。他們傷害你，只是時間問題。
A New Beginning#126.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#127.src: ...I have a different perspective on this story, you might imagine. The crown has wronged me, and many others. Yet, the stories hold truths to them, to an extent.
A New Beginning#127.dst: ……你大概想得到，我對這個故事有不同的看法。王室虧欠我，也虧欠許多人。但那些故事，在某個程度上仍有它的真實。
A New Beginning#127.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#128.src: That is why your control over your power has interested me. It bears more traits of the crown's blessings than of the evil's curses, and yet...
A New Beginning#128.dst: 這就是為什麼你對力量的控制讓我感興趣。它更像王室的賜福，而不像那股邪惡的詛咒，然而……
A New Beginning#128.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#129.src: Magic... yes, that term has been used in higher studies at the University.
A New Beginning#129.dst: 魔法……是的，大學裡的高階研究用過這個詞。
A New Beginning#129.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#130.src: But a land filled with cursed ones... and it isn't destroyed? I suppose I have had no reason to believe the crown's reports about it, but...
A New Beginning#130.dst: 可是一整片土地都是受詛者……卻沒有毀滅？我想我本來也沒有理由相信王室對那邊的報告，只是……
A New Beginning#130.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#131.src: I need time to process this information. But I would like to discuss it with you further, at a later date, if you would be willing.
A New Beginning#131.dst: 我需要一點時間消化這些消息。不過我希望日後能跟你再談得深一點，如果你願意的話。
A New Beginning#131.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#132.src: Then that leads me to my final request. Would you join our cause, and offer your help to our resistance group? Your knowledge and strength would be greatly appreciated.
A New Beginning#132.dst: 那麼，這就帶到我最後一個請求。你願不願意加入我們的目標，向我們的反抗組織伸出援手？你的知識與力量會是莫大的助力。
A New Beginning#132.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#133.src: Thank you. I will take you to meet with the others, then. Our home is directly to the south-west, it should be hard to miss. I'll meet you there.
A New Beginning#133.dst: 謝謝你。那我帶你去見其他人。我們的家就在西南邊，很難錯過。我們在那裡碰面。
A New Beginning#133.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#134.src: Follow Syndra to the resistance base at .
A New Beginning#134.dst: 跟著 Syndra 前往  的反抗軍基地。

A New Beginning#135.src: There you are, {u}. I see you found your way here alright.
A New Beginning#135.dst: 你來了，{u}。看來你順利找到路了。
A New Beginning#135.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#136.src: If you're going to be joining us, I should introduce you to the others.
A New Beginning#136.dst: 你既然要加入我們，我該把你介紹給其他人。
A New Beginning#136.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#137.src: Ahem... Children, come on out! We have a new member I'd like you to meet.
A New Beginning#137.dst: 咳咳……孩子們，都出來！有位新成員我想介紹給你們。
A New Beginning#137.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#138.src: We m-meet again! I knew you'd be a g-good fit!
A New Beginning#138.dst: 我、我們又見面了！我就知道你很適、適合！
A New Beginning#138.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#139.src: Yeah, Zeph, we know. You've been saying so for hours...
A New Beginning#139.dst: 是是是，Zeph，我們知道。你已經講了好幾個小時了……
A New Beginning#139.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#140.src: Ah, lighten up Rex. Welcome to the Leaves, friend! No matter your origin, if Syndra believes you to be trustworthy, it must be so.
A New Beginning#140.dst: 好啦，別繃著臉，Rex。歡迎加入風中之葉，朋友！不管你從哪裡來，只要 Syndra 認為你值得信任，那就必然如此。
A New Beginning#140.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#141.src: On that subject, {u} here is from outside of our province. They'll be joining our resistance against the crown...
A New Beginning#141.dst: 說到這個，這位 {u} 是我們行省之外來的。他們會加入我們對抗王室的行動……
A New Beginning#141.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#142.src: ...and, hopefully, they'll be able to help me resolve some theories I have on the nature of curses and blessings.
A New Beginning#142.dst: ……而且但願，他們能幫我釐清我對詛咒與賜福本質的一些推想。
A New Beginning#142.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#144.src: Yes. But they're no threat to us. We share the same enemies. And, having that power on our side could make a huge difference for our efforts.
A New Beginning#144.dst: 是的。但他們對我們沒有威脅。我們有共同的敵人。而且，把那份力量拉到我們這一邊，會讓我們的努力產生很大的差別。
A New Beginning#144.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#145.src: Hm... are you certain, miss? I do trust your judgment, but perhaps it would be best to err on the side of caution when dealing with the cursed.
A New Beginning#145.dst: 嗯……您確定嗎，小姐？我信任您的判斷，不過在跟受詛者打交道這件事上，或許還是謹慎一點為上。
A New Beginning#145.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#146.src: The curse is the least of our problems! Are we really blindly trusting someone who says they're from Wynn? People don't just... just... come back from there!
A New Beginning#146.dst: 詛咒是我們問題裡最小的一個！我們真的要盲目相信一個自稱從 Wynn 來的人嗎？沒有人會就這樣……就這樣……從那裡回來啊！
A New Beginning#146.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#147.src: That's enough, Rex. I understand your misgivings, but I have reasons for my trust. I would ask you to have faith in me.
A New Beginning#147.dst: 夠了，Rex。我理解你的疑慮，但我信任他們是有理由的。我請你也信任我。
A New Beginning#147.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#149.src: Now. I still need to acquire the proper papers for {u} to be able to access {p}. In the meantime, why don't you all get to know each other properly?
A New Beginning#149.dst: 好了。我還得幫 {u} 弄到能進 {p} 的正式文件。在那之前，你們幾個何不好好認識一下彼此？
A New Beginning#149.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#151.src: Introduce yourself to the Resistance Members are .
A New Beginning#151.dst: 到  向反抗軍的成員們自我介紹。

A New Beginning#152.src: ...What do you want? Do you need something?
A New Beginning#152.dst: ……你想幹嘛？你需要什麼東西嗎？
A New Beginning#152.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#153.src: I... shoot things? With my bow?
A New Beginning#153.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#154.src: I'm a tactician, otherwise. Not the tactician that'd be Syndra but... y'know.
A New Beginning#154.dst: 其他時候我是戰術官。不是「那個」戰術官——那是 Syndra——但是……你懂的。
A New Beginning#154.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#155.src: ...You don't know. Because look, it doesn't matter what I do! Not to you, at least.
A New Beginning#155.dst: ……你不懂。因為，聽著，我做什麼根本不重要！至少對你不重要。
A New Beginning#155.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#156.src: What, are you looking for gossip?
A New Beginning#156.dst: 怎樣，你是來打聽八卦的？
A New Beginning#156.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#157.src: Well, you're not going to get any out of me.
A New Beginning#157.dst: 那你從我這裡是問不出東西的。
A New Beginning#157.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#158.src: No, you didn't ugh! It's not you personally, it's just...
A New Beginning#158.dst: 不，你沒有——唉！不是針對你，只是……
A New Beginning#158.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#160.src: You're cursed, and you say you're from Wynn. Both of those are problems.
A New Beginning#160.dst: 你是受詛的，而且你說你從 Wynn 來。這兩件事都是問題。
A New Beginning#160.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#161.src: I don't know what Syndra sees in you... but whatever it is, it'd better make up for both of those things.
A New Beginning#161.dst: 我不知道 Syndra 看上你哪一點……但不管是什麼，最好抵得過那兩件事。
A New Beginning#161.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#163.src: Well, welcome to the Leaves in the Wind! Pardon on the hesitation earlier, the cursed are a… sensitive subject. If Syndra believes you to be safe, I will choose to believe her.
A New Beginning#163.dst: 那麼，歡迎加入風中之葉！先前的猶豫請多包涵，受詛者這個話題……有點敏感。既然 Syndra 認為你安全，我就選擇相信她。
A New Beginning#163.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#164.src: It’s always nice to have some fresh blood under our canopy! No matter how abnormal. We may wait for Syndra’s return before getting you properly settled in.
A New Beginning#164.dst: 我們的樹冠底下多一點新血總是好事！不管有多不尋常。等 Syndra 回來，我們再好好安頓你。
A New Beginning#164.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#165.src: If you have any issues whatsoever, don’t hesitate to inform me!
A New Beginning#165.dst: 你要是有任何問題，儘管來找我！
A New Beginning#165.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#166.src: Now, what could I do for you?
A New Beginning#166.dst: 那麼，有什麼我能效勞的嗎？
A New Beginning#166.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#167.src: I am Syndra’s right hand! I deal with many of the tasks involving our family here, to lighten the workload she places upon herself.
A New Beginning#167.dst: 我是 Syndra 的左右手！這裡許多跟大家有關的事務都由我處理，好減輕她自己扛的擔子。
A New Beginning#167.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#168.src: Such tasks could include onboarding new recruits, assigning members to various missions… handling disputes- that sort of thing.
A New Beginning#168.dst: 這些事務包括接待新成員、把人分派到各種任務上……處理糾紛——諸如此類。
A New Beginning#168.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#169.src: Of course, my “official” occupation by the crown’s terms is that of a lumberjack. Fighting for a better future isn’t exactly a well paying job, hoho!
A New Beginning#169.dst: 當然，照王室那邊的說法，我「正式」的職業是伐木工。為更好的將來奮鬥，可不是什麼待遇優渥的差事，呵呵！
A New Beginning#169.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#170.src: Ah! Yes, well, these are not our full numbers. The others live elsewhere, either in town or in various villages. They stop by every so often, so perhaps you’ll have the chance to meet them later!
A New Beginning#170.dst: 啊！是的，我們的人不只這些。其他人住在別處，有的在鎮上，有的在各個村子。他們偶爾會過來，說不定你以後有機會見到！
A New Beginning#170.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#171.src: We all are the ones who live here full-time. Nowhere else in particular we can go, if you catch my meaning.
A New Beginning#171.dst: 我們這幾個是全天住在這裡的。沒有別的地方可去——你懂我的意思的話。
A New Beginning#171.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#172.src: If you’re from beyond our province’s walls, I expect we’ll be wanting to set you up with a room of your own sometime… but we can discuss that later.
A New Beginning#172.dst: 如果你真是從我們行省的牆外來的，我想我們得找個時間給你安排一間自己的房間……不過那可以晚點再談。
A New Beginning#172.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#173.src: Indeed. I hope we can do some good work together, young leaf!
A New Beginning#173.dst: 正是如此。希望我們能一起做點好事，小葉子！
A New Beginning#173.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#174.src: Um... nice to meet you, I guess?
A New Beginning#174.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#175.src: Oh... I take care of the injured. I also cook... sometimes.
A New Beginning#175.dst: 哦……我負責照顧傷患。我有時候……也煮飯。
A New Beginning#175.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#176.src: I'm not really much of a fighter... not much of, um, anything, really.
A New Beginning#176.dst: 我不太會打架……其實也不太會，呃，什麼都不太會。
A New Beginning#176.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#177.src: I'm mostly just here because of Mora... he's, um, my brother.
A New Beginning#177.dst: 我基本上是因為 Mora 才在這裡的……他，呃，是我哥哥。
A New Beginning#177.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#179.src: Um... wait, can I ask actually... nevermind.
A New Beginning#179.dst: 呃……等等，我可以問一下——其實，算了。
A New Beginning#179.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#180.src: I'm g-glad you were able to c-convince Syndra to let you j-join! It'll be n-nice having someone new a-around.
A New Beginning#180.dst: 我很高、高興你能說服 Syndra 讓你加、加入！身邊多一個新人挺、挺好的。
A New Beginning#180.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#182.src: I... d-don't know, actually. It looks like she's h-heading towards the F-Frog Tavern... but why...?
A New Beginning#182.dst: 我……其實不、不知道。看起來她好像往青、青蛙酒館去了……可是為什麼……？
A New Beginning#182.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#183.src: Hey... {u}. How'd you l-like to have your first of-official resistance mission with me?
A New Beginning#183.dst: 欸……{u}。你想不想跟我一起執、執行你的第一個正式反抗軍任務？
A New Beginning#183.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#184.src: I-I want to f-follow her and see what she g-gets up to at a r-random bar, of all places...
A New Beginning#184.dst: 我、我想跟上去看看她在一間普、普通的酒吧到底要做什麼……
A New Beginning#184.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#185.src: You know, I-I-I've always suspected that the t-tavern isn't what it a-appears to be!
A New Beginning#185.dst: 你知道嗎，我、我、我一直懷疑那間酒館沒、沒有表面上那麼單純！
A New Beginning#185.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#186.dst: ……其他人都覺得我疑、疑神疑鬼。
A New Beginning#186.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#188.src: Wh- I- n-no! I j-just want to m-m-make sure she's okay. Th-that's all.
A New Beginning#188.dst: 什——我——不、不是！我只是想確、確認她沒事。就、就這樣而已。
A New Beginning#188.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#189.src: Let's m-meet up at the tavern. It's j-just to the north of here.
A New Beginning#189.dst: 我們在酒館碰、碰面。就在這北、北邊。
A New Beginning#189.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#190.src: I m-mainly gather intel for the resistance! Th-that usually involves needing to st-stay hidden.
A New Beginning#190.dst: 我主要是幫反抗軍蒐、蒐集情報！那通常需要一直躲、躲著。
A New Beginning#190.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#191.src: I've picked up a t-t-trick or two over the y-years.
A New Beginning#191.dst: 這些年我學、學會了一、一兩招。
A New Beginning#191.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#192.src: S-sometimes I sell stuff I f-find in the forest in town! B-but that's not really f-for the resistance. That's for m-me.
A New Beginning#192.dst: 有、有時候我會把在森林裡撿到的東西拿到鎮上賣！但那不、不算反抗軍的事。那是我自、自己的。
A New Beginning#192.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#193.src: Huh? Oh, r-right! I was l-looking for guard rotations, for th-the upcoming festival.
A New Beginning#193.dst: 啊？哦，對！我剛才在查衛、衛兵的輪班表，為了接下來的慶、慶典。
A New Beginning#193.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#194.src: S-security is usually pretty high, so... it's g-good to know where and when is s-s-safe.
A New Beginning#194.dst: 戒備通常很森嚴，所以……知道哪裡、什麼時候安、安全是很有用的。
A New Beginning#194.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#195.src: I-I've been wondering the s-same thing...
A New Beginning#195.dst: 我、我也一直在想同一件事……
A New Beginning#195.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#196.src: She usually isn't l-like this! I wonder if s-something's wrong...
A New Beginning#196.dst: 她平常不會這、這樣的！我在想是不是出、出了什麼事……
A New Beginning#196.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#197.src: ...I can t-talk to her about it later.
A New Beginning#197.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#199.src: Meet up with Zeph outside the Frog Tavern at .
A New Beginning#199.dst: 到  的青蛙酒館外跟 Zeph 會合。

A New Beginning#200.src: W-wait. We can't j-just go through the f-front, she'll s-see us.
A New Beginning#200.dst: 等、等一下。我們不能直、直接從正門進去，她會看、看到我們。
A New Beginning#200.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#202.src: You'll get s-spotted! Let's get in from above i-instead.
A New Beginning#202.dst: 你會被發、發現的！我們從上、上面進去。
A New Beginning#202.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#203.src: Sneak into the Frog Tavern at .

A New Beginning#204.src: R-right behind you. D-don't get spotted!
A New Beginning#204.dst: 我就跟、跟在你後面。別被發、發現了！
A New Beginning#204.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#205.src: Th-there she is! I w-wonder what she's
A New Beginning#205.dst: 她、她在那裡！我在想她到底在——
A New Beginning#205.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#208.src: You interrupt my sequence like this and won't even say my name? Come on, now.
A New Beginning#208.dst: 你這樣打斷我的數列，還連我的名字都不叫？別這樣嘛。
A New Beginning#208.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#209.src: Bartender, my usual mix. I need a boost.
A New Beginning#209.dst: 酒保，老樣子調一杯。我需要提振一下。
A New Beginning#209.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#211.src: Oh, thank you for noticing! It's because of the stress. Look, I know you're aware of the attack on Torann by now. You've always kept up with the details.
A New Beginning#211.dst: 哦，謝謝你注意到！那正是因為壓力。聽著，我知道你現在已經曉得 Torann 那場襲擊了。你一向掌握得很清楚。
A New Beginning#211.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#212.src: But how about we accelerate this. You know how little time I have and you didn't bring me here just for drinks.
A New Beginning#212.dst: 不過我們加速一下吧。你知道我時間有多少——而且你把我叫來這裡，不會只是為了喝酒。
A New Beginning#212.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#213.src: Skipping the small talk, I see. Are my intentions really that transparent?
A New Beginning#213.dst: 直接跳過寒暄啊。我的意圖真的那麼一目了然嗎？
A New Beginning#213.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#214.src: Predictable, more like, after all this time. You've always got an angle you're working towards when you call me here.
A New Beginning#214.dst: 該說是可預測。都這麼多年了。你每次把我叫來，都有一個你想切進去的角度。
A New Beginning#214.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#215.src: Maybe I just like the ambience.
A New Beginning#215.dst: 說不定我只是喜歡這裡的氣氛。
A New Beginning#215.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#216.src: ...I need another passport. Same as the rest.
A New Beginning#216.dst: ……我需要再一份通行證。跟之前那些一樣。
A New Beginning#216.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#217.src: Naturally. You and your trend for collecting strays... Really you should just start a family by this point.
A New Beginning#217.dst: 那當然。你跟你那個蒐集流浪貓狗的老毛病……講真的，你到這個地步乾脆成個家算了。
A New Beginning#217.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#218.src: You of all people should know that I can't just stand by and leave them to fend for themselves.
A New Beginning#218.dst: 這種話別人說得，你說不得。你比誰都清楚我沒辦法袖手旁觀、放著他們自生自滅。
A New Beginning#218.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#219.src: Yes... A toddler could calculate that by watching you. I'll solve that problem for you. Keep them out of trouble, and we won't have any issues as usual.
A New Beginning#219.dst: 是啊……這一題連個學步的小孩看著你都算得出來。這個問題我幫你解掉。別讓他們惹麻煩，我們之間就不會有問題——老規矩。
A New Beginning#219.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#220.src: Of course. As I always do.
A New Beginning#220.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#221.src: Ha! "Always." If I were a gambling man I'd never bet on your odds.
A New Beginning#221.dst: 哈！「一向」。我要是個賭徒，絕不會押你的賠率。
A New Beginning#221.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#222.src: I need to get moving. There's always something that needs me to crunch the numbers... and today's events have only added to the pile.
A New Beginning#222.dst: 我得走了。永遠有事情等著我去算那些數字……而今天發生的事又往那堆上面加了一疊。
A New Beginning#222.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#223.src: I certainly wouldn't want to delay you, Sovereign. I hope you manage to sort out all these problems.
A New Beginning#223.dst: 我當然不會耽誤您，統領大人。希望您能把這些問題都理清。
A New Beginning#223.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#224.src: Oh, we will. It's only a matter of time. Take care, Syndra. Keep it constant.
A New Beginning#224.dst: 哦，我們會的。那只是時間問題。保重，Syndra。保持常數。
A New Beginning#224.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#226.src: Sigh. You may as well come down now. Zeph, {u}.
A New Beginning#226.dst: 唉。你們也差不多可以下來了。Zeph，{u}。
A New Beginning#226.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#228.src: That was... risky. You're lucky he didn't look up.
A New Beginning#228.dst: 那實在是……太冒險了。你們運氣好，他沒有抬頭。
A New Beginning#228.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#229.src: S-sure, but- b-but what were you d-doing meeting up w-with him?!
A New Beginning#229.dst: 是、是沒錯，可是——可是你跟他碰面到底是在做什麼？！
A New Beginning#229.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#230.src: Its... complicated we have something of an agreement. What matters is that everything is taken care of. Since you're here, {u}, take this. Your passport.
A New Beginning#230.dst: 這……很複雜——我們之間算是有個協議。重點是每件事都處理好了。{u}，既然你在這裡，拿去。你的通行證。
A New Beginning#230.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#231.src: He's... h-he's with the c-crown, though. H-how can you t-trust him?
A New Beginning#231.dst: 可是他……他是王、王室那邊的人。你怎、怎麼能信任他？
A New Beginning#231.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#232.src: Simple I don't. You don't need to worry about him. As I said, we have an agreement. He doesn't know about anything we do.
A New Beginning#232.dst: 很簡單——我不信任他。他的事你不用擔心。我說過了，我們有協議。我們做的任何事他都不知道。
A New Beginning#232.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#233.src: I had hoped to keep this a secret for a reason... but what's done is done. Just... don't do anything rash, would you?
A New Beginning#233.dst: 我本來希望這件事能繼續保密，是有原因的……不過事情既然發生了就是發生了。只是……別做什麼衝動的事，好嗎？
A New Beginning#233.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#234.src: {u}, your passport will let you enter the city. I'd suggest you take some time to visit and look around, to familiarize yourself with the place.
A New Beginning#234.dst: {u}，你的通行證可以讓你進城。我建議你花點時間去走走看看，熟悉一下那個地方。
A New Beginning#234.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#235.src: And when you have time... I'd like to follow up on our discussion we had earlier. I think it's time we start taking steps forward.
A New Beginning#235.dst: 等你有空的時候……我想把我們稍早的那段討論接下去。我想是時候往前踏出一步了。
A New Beginning#235.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#236.src: I'll be returning to our home. Zeph, you can come with me if you'd like.
A New Beginning#236.dst: 我要回我們的家去了。Zeph，你想的話可以跟我一起走。
A New Beginning#236.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#237.dst: 我、我想也是……那晚點見了，{u}。
A New Beginning#237.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#239.src: Ugh. What do you want? I'm clearly busy.
A New Beginning#239.dst: 唉。你想幹嘛？我明明就在忙。
A New Beginning#239.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#241.src: No, just... leave me alone, okay? I don't want to talk to you.
A New Beginning#241.dst: 不，就……讓我一個人待著，好嗎？我不想跟你說話。
A New Beginning#241.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#244.src: Ah! You ca-caught- caught me off guard. How's your time in Auburn bee-been?
A New Beginning#244.dst: 啊！你嚇、嚇——嚇我一跳。你在 Auburn 過、過得還好嗎？
A New Beginning#244.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#245.src: Yup! I've s-s-stayed here the longest so I've ma-managed to gather quite the assortment of useful stuff. Rex w-w-would call it junk but...
A New Beginning#245.dst: 是啊！我在這裡待、待最久，所以蒐集了不、不少有用的東西。Rex 會、會說那是破爛，不過……
A New Beginning#245.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#246.src: An old friend a-actually helped me make this training dum-dummy.
A New Beginning#246.dst: 這個訓練假、假人其實是一個老朋友幫我做的。
A New Beginning#246.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#247.src: Gotta stay on t-top of my training! Especially with you here.
A New Beginning#247.dst: 訓練不、不能鬆懈！尤其是你來了之後。
A New Beginning#247.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#248.src: Besides, I wa-wa-want I want to be able to help when it matters.
A New Beginning#248.dst: 再說，我想、我想——我希望在關鍵的時候幫得上忙。
A New Beginning#248.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#249.src: We should t-train together some day.
A New Beginning#249.dst: 我們哪天該一、一起訓練。
A New Beginning#249.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#251.src: Did you... need help with anything?
A New Beginning#251.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#252.src: Mhm! Me, Zeph, Rex, and Mora all, um, have rooms here. Oh, and Syndra, too. And Kaio lives nearby too...
A New Beginning#252.dst: 嗯！我、Zeph、Rex 還有 Mora，呃，都在這裡有房間。哦，還有 Syndra。Kaio 也住在附近……
A New Beginning#252.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#253.src: I've... been meaning to decorate some more. You know... make it more, um, homely.
A New Beginning#253.dst: 我……一直想再多布置一點。你知道的……讓它更，呃，像個家。
A New Beginning#253.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#254.src: ...but life's been getting in the way, I suppose.
A New Beginning#254.dst: ……但生活好像總是有別的事插進來。
A New Beginning#254.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#255.src: Um! I d-don't, ha, judge me for this, but... I'm, um, writing in my diary.
A New Beginning#255.dst: 呃！我，呃——哈，你不要笑我——我在，呃，寫日記。
A New Beginning#255.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#256.src: ...a-and before you ask! No!! You're, um, not allowed to read it.
A New Beginning#256.dst: ……而、而且你先別問！不行！！你，呃，不可以看。
A New Beginning#256.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#257.src: ...thank you. I'll, um, see you later.
A New Beginning#257.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#258.src: Hmm... Delivering mail from river settlement to {p}... Kaio... Check... Hmmm.
A New Beginning#258.dst: 嗯……把信從河邊聚落送到 {p}……Kaio……勾起來……嗯——
A New Beginning#258.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#259.src: Ah! {u}, do you require my assistance?
A New Beginning#259.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#260.src: Ah... You overheard me talking to myself, then. Hoh!
A New Beginning#260.dst: 啊……那你剛才聽到我自言自語了。呵！
A New Beginning#260.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#261.src: I am just writing and filing some reports I had forgotten about. We are trying to keep better track of our activities throughout the forest, you see.
A New Beginning#261.dst: 我只是在寫幾份我忘掉的報告、順便歸檔。你知道的，我們在想辦法把我們在森林裡的活動記錄得更清楚。
A New Beginning#261.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#263.src: Hm... I guess not, thinking on it now. A few years ago, had you asked, I'd've probably said yes. But I don't got the strength in me for it anymore.
A New Beginning#263.dst: 嗯……現在想想，我猜是不會。要是幾年前你問我，我大概會說會。但我身上已經沒有那股勁了。
A New Beginning#263.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#264.src: It's good your arrival has given Syndra and the younguns some hope, for once. We've been a bit, eh... lacking in it lately.
A New Beginning#264.dst: 你的到來讓 Syndra 和那些年輕人總算有了點希望，這是好事。我們最近……欸，就是有點缺這個。
A New Beginning#264.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#265.src: I've got no such delusions, unfortunately. I reckon this path only ends in tragedy. But it's not my place to say so, so I don't.
A New Beginning#265.dst: 可惜我沒有那種幻想。我看這條路只會走向悲劇。但這話輪不到我說，所以我不說。
A New Beginning#265.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#266.src: Would be good to be proven wrong... but I don't think I will be. I've seen this sorta thing before.
A New Beginning#266.dst: 要是能被證明我錯了，那再好不過……但我不覺得會。這種事我見得多了。
A New Beginning#266.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#267.src: ...what? I got nothin' else to say.
A New Beginning#267.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#268.src: Interesting that you're drawn to that grave in particular. S'our latest loss, that'n there.
A New Beginning#268.dst: 你偏偏被那座墳吸引住，倒是有意思。那是我們最近的一次損失。
A New Beginning#268.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#269.src: It's a damn shame. A tragedy each 'n every time, yet still happens often enough to feel routine. But that's life, I reckon.
A New Beginning#269.dst: 真他媽可惜。每一次都是一場悲劇，可發生得夠頻繁了，頻繁到讓人覺得像例行公事。不過人生就是這樣，我看。
A New Beginning#269.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#270.src: ...did you now? Funny thing to say about a dead man, considering I ain't ever seen you 'round these parts before.
A New Beginning#270.dst: ……是嗎？對一個死人講這種話還真怪，畢竟我從來沒在這一帶見過你。
A New Beginning#270.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#271.src: Now, spill. 'Fore I go and tell Synny you ain't no good after all.
A New Beginning#271.dst: 好了，說吧。免得我去跟 Synny 講你這人終究是靠不住。
A New Beginning#271.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#272.src: Ah... caught Rex muttering something 'bout that once or twice before. Poor girl... it'd do her well to set it aside, for a time.
A New Beginning#272.dst: 啊……我以前有一兩次撞見 Rex 在嘀咕那件事。可憐的孩子……她要是能先把那個放下一陣子，對她比較好。
A New Beginning#272.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#273.src: Didn't think much of it, but I suppose you're livin' proof, aren'tcha? Strange as can be...
A New Beginning#273.dst: 我本來沒把那當回事，不過我看你就是活生生的證據，是吧？怪得可以……
A New Beginning#273.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#274.src: Say, is the memory wipin' a real thing? Got no damn clue where that theory started, but... well, if one thing's true, why not the rest?
A New Beginning#274.dst: 欸，抹掉記憶那件事是真的嗎？那個說法從哪冒出來的我他媽完全沒頭緒，可是……欸，要是有一件是真的，其他的為什麼不會？
A New Beginning#274.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#275.src: Damn. Damn. That's rough. That real rough, ain't it. And you're tellin' me that's where he ended up?
A New Beginning#275.dst: 該死。該死。這太難受了。這真的太難受了，不是嗎。你是說他最後就落到那個地步？
A New Beginning#275.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#276.src: Hrm... y'know, it's funny. Big guy like him, you wouldn't take him for a thief. Hard to keep hidden, eh? And yet...
A New Beginning#276.dst: 唔……你知道嗎，說起來也好笑。那麼壯一個人，你不會把他跟賊聯想在一起。要藏起來多難啊，是吧？結果呢……
A New Beginning#276.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#277.src: He'd manage to turn blending into a crowd into an art. No matter where he was, who he spoke to, how he was actin', he'd always seem like he fit right in.
A New Beginning#277.dst: 他能把「混進人群」搞成一門藝術。不管人在哪、跟誰講話、擺出什麼樣子，他看起來永遠就像本來就屬於那裡。
A New Beginning#277.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#278.src: ...t'was a right stupid risk that did him in, in the end. I told him, I did it ain't worth breaking into the Sovereign's place, especially not during festival times...
A New Beginning#278.dst: ……最後要了他命的，是一次蠢到不行的冒險。我跟他說過，我說了——闖統領的地方不值得，尤其還是慶典期間……
A New Beginning#278.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#279.src: But he was the kinda sort to dig in his heels. Said he'd be fine, said it'd be worth it, nabbin' all those documents. Something to help the cause... I hardly even remember now.
A New Beginning#279.dst: 可他就是那種一旦認定就不回頭的人。他說他不會有事，說值得，說把那些文件全弄到手。說是能幫上大局的東西……我現在幾乎都記不得了。
A New Beginning#279.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#280.src: Can't save 'em all. Especially not from themselves. I've learned that many times over, over my years.
A New Beginning#280.dst: 不是每個人都救得了。尤其是救不了他們自己想找死。這道理我這輩子學過太多次了。
A New Beginning#280.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#281.src: So he got caught. Heard a cursed one got involved... was a whole damn mess. Sovereign really wasn't happy with Synny when he heard, let me tell you. Ain't seen her that shellshocked in years.
A New Beginning#281.dst: 所以他被抓了。聽說還牽扯進一個受詛者……整件事亂成一團。統領聽到消息的時候，對 Synny 可是真的不高興，我跟你說。我好幾年沒見過她那麼失魂落魄。
A New Beginning#281.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#282.src: ...but you're sayin' he lived? How's that all work out?
A New Beginning#282.dst: ……可你是說他活下來了？那是怎麼回事？
A New Beginning#282.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#284.src: Well... tell me this, then. Was he happy, you think? Out there in the wider world? Did he live a good life?
A New Beginning#284.dst: 那麼……你告訴我這個吧。你覺得，他快樂嗎？在外面那個更寬的世界裡？他過了好日子嗎？
A New Beginning#284.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#285.src: ...alright. Alrighty. Good. That that's good, y'hear. I... I'm glad for that much.
A New Beginning#285.dst: ……好。好啊。那就好。那——那就好，聽見沒。我……我至少為這件事高興。
A New Beginning#285.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#286.src: Thank you for... for tellin' me all that. S'not a tale that ends in happiness, but I reckon so long as he made the most of it... that's all you can really hope for.
A New Beginning#286.dst: 謝謝你……謝謝你跟我說這些。這不是一個以幸福收尾的故事，不過我想，只要他把日子過到最好……那也就是人能指望的全部了。
A New Beginning#286.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#287.src: Y'may as well leave me be a while, now. Got some thinkin' to get through.
A New Beginning#287.dst: 你先讓我一個人待一會兒吧。我有些事得想一想。
A New Beginning#287.speaker: Kaio
